Use case: background-extraction.
Asset type: production game HUD event icon sprite.
Input image 1 is the approved icon system sheet. Images 2–4 are the three finalized event sprites; match their exact warm-ivory pictogram system, thick dark-navy edge weight, restrained polished 2.5D bevel, lighting direction, saturation, padding and visual weight.
Output exactly ONE centered icon on a genuinely transparent RGBA background, square canvas, generous even transparent padding, front-facing and readable at 48–64 px. No circular medallion, container, badge, text, label, border around canvas, full scene, detached shadow or watermark. Subject: BIG WAVE. One bold curling ocean wave sweeping from left to right, primarily vivid cyan and medium ocean blue, with a single chunky warm-ivory foam crest. Use no boat, rock, face, eyes, hands, weather cloud, lightning or extra splashes. Strong simple crescent silhouette clearly distinct from the small wave under the reef icon.
